title: Condition names (Mondo, with Orphanet links)
description: Plain names, definitions and synonyms for the conditions ClinVar records name, from the Mondo Disease Ontology, with cross-references to Orphanet, OMIM and MedGen. Documents what a condition is; says nothing about you.
citation: Vasilevsky NA et al. Mondo: Unifying diseases for the world, by the world. medRxiv 2022. Orphanet cross-references: Orphanet, INSERM (CC BY 4.0)
